title: Always Good
story:
A little girl baked cookies with her grandmother.

As they mixed the ingredients, the girl tasted a bit of flour.

“It tastes bad,” she said.

Then she tried a little baking soda.

“That’s even worse!”

Her grandmother smiled.

“Wait until it’s finished.”

They continued mixing.

Sugar.

Butter.

Chocolate chips.

Everything went into the bowl.

Soon, the cookies were ready.

Warm.

Golden.

Delicious.

The girl took a bite and her eyes lit up.

“This is so good!”

Her grandmother said,

“Sometimes, the individual parts don’t taste good.

But together, they create something wonderful.”

In life, not every moment feels good.

Some experiences are difficult.

Some seasons are painful.

But God is always good.

His love never fails.

His faithfulness continues through every generation.

He is working all things together.

And in the end,

we will see His goodness clearly.
life_lesson:
Even when life doesn’t feel good, God is always good.

Trust His love and faithfulness in every season.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for Your goodness.

Thank You for Your unfailing love.

Even when I don’t understand my situation, help me to trust You.

Remind me that You are always working for my good.

Help me to remain thankful in every season.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Are you going through a season that feels difficult?

Do you believe God is still good in that situation?

What is one thing you can thank God for today?
verse:
For the Lord is good and His love endures forever.
His faithfulness continues through all generations.
